name: Dunaszentpál (Hungary)
description: White field charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Dunaszentpál: a red, blue and black shield with a church, a fish and a crescent, inscribed DUNASZENTPÁL, between ears of grain.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.
